# DeepWiki

> > DeepWiki is a comprehensive documentation platform for open-source software projects, providing detailed technical references for repositories spanning blockchain, security tools, game development, and developer utilities.

DeepWiki aggregates and organizes documentation for GitHub repositories across diverse domains including smart contracts (ERC-7857, ERC-4626), security tooling (Frida, token manipulation), VR applications, and developer libraries. The platform serves as a central knowledge base for understanding complex codebases with system architecture diagrams, API references, and implementation guides.

## Key Topics

- Smart Contracts & Blockchain
- Security & Reverse Engineering
- VR & Gaming Development
- System Architecture
- Docker & Deployment
- API Development
- Frida Instrumentation
- OSC Protocol
- Monorepo Management
- Token Manipulation
- Data Availability
- Knowledge Distillation
- ERC Standards (ERC-7857, ERC-4626)
- Python Development
- TypeScript & React

## Blockchain & Smart Contracts

- [0gfoundation/0g-agent-nft](https://deepwiki.com/0gfoundation/0g-agent-nft): ERC-7857 Agent NFT implementation with private metadata & ZKP/TEE
- [0gfoundation/0g-da-node](https://deepwiki.com/0gfoundation/0g-da-node): Data availability node with gRPC service & blockchain storage layer
- [0kn0t/case](https://deepwiki.com/0kn0t/case): ERC4626-compliant meta-vault system for DeFi asset management
- [021up/real-life-game](https://deepwiki.com/021up/real-life-game): Blockchain gaming platform with ERC-20 token rewards & GameFactory Contract

## Security & Reverse Engineering

- [0xdea/frida-scripts](https://deepwiki.com/0xdea/frida-scripts): Frida instrumentation scripts for mobile app reverse engineering
- [0xbadjuju/Tokenvator](https://deepwiki.com/0xbadjuju/Tokenvator): C# tool for Windows token manipulation & privilege escalation testing

## VR & Gaming Development

- [0suu/sai_OSCController](https://deepwiki.com/0suu/sai_OSCController): VR device telemetry bridge for VRChat using OSC protocol & SwitchBot
- [0x7c13/Pal3.Unity](https://deepwiki.com/0x7c13/Pal3.Unity): Unity recreation of Legend of Sword and Fairy 3 Chinese RPG
- [0kihS/planar](https://deepwiki.com/0kihS/planar): Infinite canvas Wayland compositor built on wlroots library

## Developer Tools & Libraries

- [07akioni/xicons](https://deepwiki.com/07akioni/xicons): SVG icon library monorepo for Vue 3 and React frameworks
- [0neDrop/mcdonalds-api](https://deepwiki.com/0neDrop/mcdonalds-api): Node.js library wrapper for McDonald's location services API
- [0x90d/videoduplicatefinder](https://deepwiki.com/0x90d/videoduplicatefinder): Video Duplicate Finder using FFmpeg for cross-platform detection
- [0oLiHano0/knowledge-distiller-kd](https://deepwiki.com/0oLiHano0/knowledge-distiller-kd): Knowledge Distiller tool for duplicate content detection in documents

## Enterprise & Web Applications

- [01-Enterprise/01-ERP-ERP002](https://deepwiki.com/01-Enterprise/01-ERP-ERP002): ERP002 enterprise system built on CodeIgniter framework
- [0d9e-tech/web](https://deepwiki.com/0d9e-tech/web): Deno-based Telegram bot with web serving & Docker deployment pipeline
- [022RaTiNdRa/TypeFast](https://deepwiki.com/022RaTiNdRa/TypeFast): Real-time multiplayer typing speed test app with Turborepo & TypeScript
- [000-ghost-000/onlinebookstore](https://deepwiki.com/000-ghost-000/onlinebookstore): Java-based e-commerce web app with three-tier architecture

## Optional

- [05mxn/python_git](https://deepwiki.com/05mxn/python_git): Match Impact Analysis system for M60 motorway traffic in Manchester
- [0raven04/Taller-Python-Jonathan-Kevin-Arana-Diaz](https://deepwiki.com/0raven04/Taller-Python-Jonathan-Kevin-Arana-Diaz): Python workshop materials for PCEP-30-02 certification preparation
